reportincident-nonemergency-sockpuppetry:
Isticmaalka akoonno badan waxaa loo oggol yahay oo keliya xaalado gaar ah. Isticmaalka aan habboonayn ee akoonno badan waxaa loo yaqaan sockpuppetry. Ma habboona in akoonno badan loo isticmaalo in lagu khiyaaneeyo ama lagu marin habaabiyo tafatirayaasha kale, lagu carqaladeeyo doodaha, lagu qalloociyo is-afgaradka, looga fogaado ciqaabaha, looga baxsado xannibaadaha, ama si kale loogu jebiyo heerarka iyo siyaasadaha bulshada.

Haddii aad ka shakisan tahay sockpuppetry, fadlan soo sheeg magacyada isticmaaleyaasha laga shakisan yahay oo bixi caddaymo taageeraya sheegashadaada.
communityconfiguration-reportincident-re: Isticmaalka aan sharciga ahayn ee akoonno badan (Sockpuppetry)
reportincident-nonemergency-vandalism-ne:
Kharibaad waa wax ka beddel xaasidnimo ah oo lagu sameeyo nuxurka aqooneed, sida ku darista [[:en:w:Wikipedia:Offensive_material|erayo aflagaaddo ah ama kaftan xun]] bog, si aan sax ahayn [[:en:w:Wikipedia:Page_blanking|looga tirtiro bogag]], ama lagu geliyo waxyaabo aan macno lahayn oo cad bog. Dadaal kasta oo daacadnimo leh oo lagu horumarinayo insaykalobiidhiya looma tixgeliyo burburin, xitaa haddii uu khaldan yahay, si ula kac ah uga hor imanayo [[:en:w:Wikipedia:Consensus|is-afgaradka]], ama uu yahay [[:en:w:Wikipedia:Disruptive_editing|tafatiro carqaladeynaya]].

Haddii aad aragto burburin, waad ku dhiirran kartaa oo waad hagaajin kartaa adiga laftaada! Haddii aadan awoodin inaad hagaajiso burburinta, raadso caawimaad.
reportincident-nonemergency-userdispute-:
Isfaham la'aanta Wikipedia waa arrin caadi ah; tafatirayaashu badanaa way isku khilaafi doonaan, gaar ahaan go'aamada la xiriira nuxurka. Waxaa laga filayaa tafatirayaasha inay si daacadnimo leh uga shaqeeyaan xalinta khilaafaadkooda, waana inaysan khilaafaadka ka dhigin kuwo shakhsi ah. Khilaafaadyo badan waxaa lagu xallin karaa iyada oo aan loo baahnayn caawimaad dibadda ah, iyadoo loo marayo tafatir tartiib ah, dood, iyo isku day lagu fahmayo diidmada saxda ah ee dadka kale.

Haddii dooddu istaagto, tafatirayaashu waxay raadsan karaan caawimaad dibadeed si ay uga caawiso xalinta khilaafka.
reportincident-nonemergency-disruptiveed:
Tafatirka carqaladeynaya waa hab tafatir oo joogto ah oo carqaladeeya horumarka lagu hagaajinayo maqaal ama lagu dhisayo insaykalobiidhiya. Tusaalooyinka caadiga ah waxaa ka mid ah dagaallada tafatirka, weerarrada shaqsiga ah, diidmada in arrimaha laga wada hadlo, ama edeb darro iyo ixtiraam la'aan.

Tafatirayaashu mararka qaarkood si kama' ah ayay u noqon karaan kuwo carqaladeynaya sababtoo ah ma aysan ogayn siyaasadaha iyo tilmaamaha. Haddii ay sidaas tahay, xusuusin saaxiibtinimo leh ayaa waxtar leh. Haddii tafatirka carqaladeynaya uu sii socdo, raadi caawimaad.
reportincident-nonemergency-other-notice: Haddii warbixintaadu ay ka kooban tahay xog xasaasi ah ama gaar ah, fadlan ku dir oo keliya iimayl.
reportincident-nonemergency-other-nextst:
Haddii aad la kulantay dhaqan aan habboonayn oo isticmaale ah oo aan ku jirin xulashooyinka kale, fadlan weydii bulshada mutadawiciinta ah ee maamusha {{SITENAME}} inay ku caawiyaan.

Nidaamka warbixinta waxaa loogu talagalay oo keliya in lagu soo sheego dhaqanka aan habboonayn ee isticmaaleyaasha. Khaladaadka ku jira nuxurka, sida qaladaadka higgaadda, macluumaad khaldan, macluumaad maqan, ama eray bixin aan wanaagsanayn, guud ahaan adiga ayaa wax ka beddeli kara. {{SITENAME}} waxaa qoro mutadawiciin, qof kastana wuu tafatiri karaa {{SITENAME}}. Haddii aad rabto inaad barato sida loo tafatiro {{SITENAME}}, eeg bogagga caawinta, ama weydii bulshada caawimaad.
